_about: Tracked default policy (plan 4.3). Per-stack overrides go in an untracked file (PA_POLICY_FILE, default <data dir>/policy.json) with the same shape: its `rules` are tried before these, its `default` replaces the one here, its `locked` is ignored. `locked` rules cannot be loosened by anything: they run first and only deny.

locked.reason: voice never approves or starts a merge, a push to main or a secret reveal, nor a factory job whose delivery could not be checked (passkey sessions, plan 7.1, will let a human tap for these)

rules.reason: the chat's action tools prompt the user on every call (Claude Code asks; AGENT.md, The PA chat acts only behind permission prompts)
the user answering the prompt for the call it names (e2e: `pa e2e` answering for the dummy call it made, audited as such)
the chat's built-in read tools; rules cannot match paths, so the caller (the SDK chat's hook) must keep them inside the chat's home
the shared MCP surface and the chat's read tools run without a prompt (their writes are small, reversible or never show a secret)
